Comment installer un plugin ?: How do I install a plugin?
Avec l'application ONIRIQUE CENTRAL, gra: With the free ONIRIQUE CENTRAL app: sign in with your account, then install the plugin in one click. It puts it in the right place and activates its licence on its own. Then rescan your DAW's plugins (in FL Studio: Options → Manage plugins → Find installed plugins).
Puis-je essayer un plugin avant de l'ach: Can I try a plugin before buying it?
Oui : chaque plugin payant s'essaie grat: Yes: every paid plugin can be tried free for 7 days, once per account. On its shop page, you can also try its interface right in your browser.
Sur combien d'ordinateurs puis-je l'util: On how many computers can I use it?
Une licence s'active sur deux ordinateur: By default, a licence works on two computers at once, for example your desktop and your laptop.
Oui. Quand une nouvelle version sort, ON: Yes. When a new version comes out, ONIRIQUE CENTRAL offers it and installs it: what changed is listed in each plugin's version history.
